scope: Slice 1A storage codecs only. Exact writes refuse loss; MOVE and arithmetic policies are later slices.
invalid_data: Invalid digits/zones, nonzero packed pad, unsigned sign not F and binary sending storage outside PIC refuse. No INVDATA compatibility claim.
negative_zero: Decode preserves signed decimal zero. Exact encode retains decimal negative zero; binary zero has no sign.
limits: Candidate output is runtime-bound Java, not idiomatic Java.
No candidate binding or gate activation; all logical slices are required before a runtime-enabled run.

conservative_refusals.unsigned_decimal_non_F_sign: Unsigned packed signs other than F and unsigned zoned zones other than F are outside this conservative valid-data profile. Decoding refuses; numeric class returns false for these signs/zones. This is not a claim that NUMPROC(NOPFD) mandates this restriction.
conservative_refusals.nonzero_even_digit_packed_pad: Decoding refuses packed-padding. Numeric class refuses packed-padding-class-unsupported instead of returning false: no IBM Enterprise COBOL 6.4 rule for classifying the unused high-order half-byte is claimed.
